newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss construction orders off sharply in Q3 - SBV.
newsitem.headline: Swiss construction orders off sharply in Q3 - SBV.

text.p: The Swiss Builders' Association SBV saw pervasive weakness in the Swiss construction sector in the third quarter, saying declines "exceed all previous negative records."
It said that the order backlog for building projects was down 18.4 percent at the end of the third quarter compared with the same 1995 period.
New orders were down 16.6 percent. Employment in the industry was down 12.6 percent. "All indicators and areas are clearly in the minus area," the SBV said.
On Friday, the Federal Statistics Office already reported that Swiss housing construction was down 18 percent in the third quarter compared with the same period of 1995.
